name: TOTP Recovery Codes
description: Displays the fresh recovery codes issued after TOTP enrollment succeeds so the user can save them before leaving the enrollment behavior.

web.notes: Confirmation stores the returned recovery-code list only in ephemeral client flow state and navigates here for presentation.

mobile.notes: Mobile renders the recovery-code list returned by the confirmation server operation from ephemeral AuthFlowContext state and exposes the canonical Done action.

notes: Recovery codes are the output of the confirmation server operation and therefore belong on a destination view rather than as a mutated state of auth.mfa.totp.confirm.
